frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs (the relation the THINGS papers adopt), with S4G's disc scale length (Salo et al. 2015): 368 pc. The same thickness as the image layers' slabs; for young objects it is an upper value. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Optically identified supernova remnants of M81 from the compilation of Vucetic et al. (2015): one dot per remnant at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the supernova-remnant color M31's and M33's dots share. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
